Hi all —

Quick technical summary and recommendations for the POC load test and Dedicated window: 
- Dedicated trial: yes, we can provision a single-week Dedicated pool for the POC; lead time is ~48 hours to reserve GPUs once we have an approved PO or trial request form.
- Recommended baseline quota: request a bump to 50,000 tokens/min initially to give headroom for concurrency and retries; we can scale down if the tests show lower needs.
- Rate limits: set per-client 10 requests/sec with a 5-second burst tolerance; use continuous batching on our side to reduce latency variance.
- Model variants: if you expect short replies, prefer the "redwood-mini-v2" quantized variant for lower latency; keep a canary route to a higher-quality variant if output drops.
- Routing guidance: configure a routing policy that pins 10% of traffic to the higher-quality variant for side-by-side comparison; otherwise route to the faster variant.
- Load test config: see attached loadtest-config.yaml for k6-style parameters (prompt list, concurrency ramp).

Pre-reqs from DataShift before the hands-on:
- Confirm expected peak QPS and typical token distribution (short/medium/long)
- Provide a sample prompt set (we'll keep it redacted)

I'll be available to join the hands-on session for prompt review and to help run the initial load.
